Title: Generally available: Azure Blob Storage Cold Tier in Poland Central, Qatar Central and Azure China

Body.Content:
Azure Blob Storage Cold Tier was generally available since Aug 10th, 2023. It is a new online access tier that is the most cost-effective Azure Blob offering for storing infrequently accessed data with long-term retention requirements, while providing instant access.

Azure Blob Storage Cold Tier is now available in more regions, including Poland Central, Qatar Central and all regions in Azure China.

See more information in Azure Blob Storage Access Tiers.
